  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import lstsq
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def calibrate_affine_gauges(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, check_group: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float, prior: np.ndarray | None = None, pair_span: float = 0.05, consensus_span: float = 0.10, residual_tol: float = 0.001) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return [gain, physical bias] and local identification flags in groups order.

    A positive affine transfer is assumed for each gauge. Pair spans and error
    thresholds are fractions of stress_scale. A local fit needs at least three
    checks and a strict majority. No ridge is used on the consensus. Otherwise
    hold the prior gain fixed and update bias by the median of compatible spot
    residuals. Supply the latest identified map per group from earlier sweeps;
    the default (1, 0) is nominal, not evidence of calibration. Nonfinite checks
    are omitted. Check pairs are unordered and enumerated once.
    """
    if not (np.isfinite([stress_scale, pair_span, consensus_span, residual_tol]).all()
            and stress_scale > 0 and 0 < pair_span <= consensus_span and residual_tol > 0):
        raise ValueError('expected positive scale and ordered calibration thresholds')
    x, y = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) / stress_scale for v in (command, measured))
    labels, groups = np.asarray(check_group), np.asarray(groups)
    if x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or labels.shape != x.shape or groups.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected matching check vectors and a group vector')
    maps = np.tile([1., 0.], (len(groups), 1)) if prior is None else np.array(prior, dtype=float, copy=True)
    if maps.shape != (len(groups), 2) or not np.isfinite(maps).all() or np.any(maps[:, 0] <= 0):
        raise ValueError('each group requires a finite prior with positive gain')
    maps[:, 1] /= stress_scale
    local = np.zeros(len(groups), dtype=bool)
    finite = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y)
    for k, label in enumerate(groups):
        take = finite & (labels == label)
        a, b = x[take], y[take]
        design = np.column_stack((a, np.ones(a.size)))
        needed = max(3, a.size // 2 + 1)
        if a.size >= needed and np.ptp(a) >= consensus_span:
            i, j = np.triu_indices(a.size, 1)
            sep = a[j] - a[i]
            use = np.abs(sep) >= pair_span
            slope = (b[j[use]] - b[i[use]]) / sep[use]
            candidates = np.vstack((maps[k], np.column_stack((slope, b[i[use]] - slope * a[i[use]]))))
            best = None
            origin = maps[k].copy()
            for trial in candidates[candidates[:, 0] > 0]:
                keep = np.abs(b - design @ trial) <= residual_tol
                if keep.sum() < needed or np.ptp(a[keep]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                fit = np.linalg.lstsq(design[keep], b[keep], rcond=None)[0]
                err = b - design @ fit
                clean = np.abs(err) <= residual_tol
                if fit[0] <= 0 or clean.sum() < needed or np.ptp(a[clean]) < consensus_span:
                    continue
                score = (-clean.sum(), np.linalg.norm((fit - origin) * [max(1., np.ptp(a)), 1.]), err[clean] @ err[clean])
                if best is None or score < best:
                    best, maps[k], local[k] = score, fit, True
        if not local[k]:
            delta = b - design @ maps[k]
            near = np.abs(delta) <= residual_tol
            if near.any():
                maps[k, 1] += np.median(delta[near])
    maps[:, 1] *= stress_scale
    return maps, local


def align_reference_features(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, group: np.ndarray, stratum: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned imputed features and the original entrywise missing mask.

    Each group shares a positive affine measurement transform between signal
    and comparable reference coupons. Take medians of reference-column means
    and population standard deviations (at least two finite values per column).
    Fill each feature with the equally weighted mean of its supported cell
    means. Pass all authorized unlabeled rows. No scale floor or zero-fill
    regularization is used: unsupported reference scales or features raise.
    """
    x, panel = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (raw, reference))
    group, stratum = np.asarray(group), np.asarray(stratum)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not x.size or panel.ndim != 2 or len(panel) != len(x) or group.shape != (len(x),) or stratum.shape != group.shape:
        raise ValueError('expected feature and reference matrices and matching label vectors')
    _, g = np.unique(group, return_inverse=True)
    _, s = np.unique(stratum, return_inverse=True)
    g, s = g.ravel(), s.ravel()
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    aligned = np.empty_like(x)
    for lab in np.unique(g):
        rows = g == lab
        ref = panel[rows]
        finite = np.isfinite(ref)
        use = finite.sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not use.any():
            raise ValueError('each group needs an estimable reference panel')
        ref = np.where(finite[:, use], ref[:, use], np.nan)
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(ref, axis=0))
        gain = np.median(np.nanstd(ref, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite(center) or not np.isfinite(gain) or gain <= 0:
            raise ValueError('reference location and positive scale must be finite')
        aligned[rows] = (np.where(observed[rows], x[rows], np.nan) - center) / gain
    cells, inverse = np.unique(np.column_stack((g, s)), axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    inverse = inverse.ravel()
    count = np.zeros((len(cells), x.shape[1]))
    total = np.zeros_like(count)
    np.add.at(count, inverse, observed)
    np.add.at(total, inverse, np.where(observed, aligned, 0.))
    support = (count > 0).sum(axis=0)
    if np.any(support == 0):
        raise ValueError('every feature needs observations in at least one cell')
    means = np.divide(total, count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
    return np.where(observed, aligned, means.sum(axis=0) / support), ~observed


def fit_predict_thresholded(history: np.ndarray, hold: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, initial_strain: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, missing: np.ndarray, training: np.ndarray, strain_observed: np.ndarray, rate_observed: np.ndarray, *, time_scale: float, stress_scale: float, strain_scale: float, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], min_complete: int = 12, rank_rtol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return physical taus, hereditary weights, plastic weights, strain, and rate.

    Use calibrated stress and zero memory before the chronological piecewise
    constant history (n, h). Durations (h,) and hold times (k,) are shared;
    features (n, p) are aligned and imputed; missing records original gaps.
    Nonfinite observations are absent. Fit only training rows, preferring at
    least min_complete complete rows if they retain observed plastic support.
    Positive hold time or an onset rate is needed to observe a plastic term.
    Reject active terms without training support or a locally rank-deficient
    fit. An inactive term has exactly zero weight.

    Use dimensionless projected multistart initialization (soft-L1 scale .05)
    and two joint Cauchy refinements at 2.5 times per-channel scaled MAD (MAD
    floor 1e-7). No coefficient ridge is used. On nontraining rows, a finite
    onset observation and missing features permit a drift-only update, with
    variance-ratio shrinkage estimated from training features and residuals.
    The prediction returns all rows. Hereditary weights are two compliances,
    then the drift intercept and feature slopes. Plastic weights multiply
    signed squared hold overstress times t, and integrated squared history
    overstress times signed hold stress times the fast-mode step response.
    """
    scales = np.array([time_scale, stress_scale, strain_scale, yield_stress, rank_rtol])
    if not np.isfinite(scales).all() or np.any(scales <= 0) or min_complete < 1:
        raise ValueError('expected positive physical scales and fit thresholds')
    h = np.asarray(history, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    p = np.asarray(hold, dtype=float) / stress_scale
    d = np.asarray(durations, dtype=float) / time_scale
    t = np.asarray(times, dtype=float) / time_scale
    x, initial, observed = (np.asarray(v, dtype=float) for v in (features, initial_strain, strain_observed))
    miss, train = np.asarray(missing, dtype=bool), np.asarray(training, dtype=bool)
    rate_unit = strain_scale / time_scale
    rate = np.asarray(rate_observed, dtype=float) / rate_unit
    n = p.size
    if p.shape != (n,) or d.ndim != 1 or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size or h.shape != (n, d.size) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or miss.shape != x.shape or observed.shape != (n, t.size) or any(v.shape != (n,) for v in (initial, train, rate)):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent specimen or time dimensions')
    lo, hi = np.asarray(tau_bounds, dtype=float) / time_scale
    if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (h, p, d, t, x, initial)) or not 0 < lo < hi < np.inf or np.any(d < 0) or t[0] < 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0):
        raise ValueError('expected finite inputs, nonnegative intervals and increasing hold times')
    eps = (observed - initial[:, None]) / strain_scale
    limit = yield_stress / stress_scale
    ov = np.sign(p) * np.maximum(0., np.abs(p) - limit) ** 2
    work = (np.maximum(0., np.abs(h) - limit) ** 2 @ d) * p
    plastic = np.column_stack((ov, work))
    active = (plastic != 0).any(axis=0)
    informative = np.isfinite(rate) | np.isfinite(eps[:, t > 0]).any(axis=1)
    complete = train & ~miss.any(axis=1)

    def supported(rows: np.ndarray) -> bool:
        return bool(np.all((plastic[rows & informative] != 0).any(axis=0)[active]))

    use = complete if (complete & informative).sum() >= min_complete and supported(complete) else train
    if not supported(use):
        raise ValueError('active plastic term lacks training excitation')
    cr, cc = np.nonzero(use[:, None] & np.isfinite(eps))
    rr = np.flatnonzero(use & np.isfinite(rate))
    cov = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    k = len(cr)
    base = 2 + cov.shape[1]
    cols = np.r_[np.ones(base, dtype=bool), active]
    width = int(cols.sum())
    if not k or not rr.size or k + rr.size < width + 2:
        raise ValueError('insufficient training curve and rate observations')
    y = np.r_[eps[cr, cc], rate[rr]]
    tail = np.r_[np.cumsum(d[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if d.size else d
    tc = t[cc, None]
    fit_rows, inverse = np.unique(np.r_[cr, rr], return_inverse=True)
    ci, ri = inverse[:k], inverse[k:]
    log_lo, log_hi = np.log([lo, hi])

    def unpack(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        first = log_lo + (log_hi - log_lo) * q[0]
        return np.exp([first, first + (log_hi - first) * q[1]])

    def jump(tau: np.ndarray, rows: np.ndarray | slice) -> np.ndarray:
        kernel = np.exp(-tail[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-d[:, None] / tau)
        return p[rows, None] - h[rows] @ kernel

    def design(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        tau = unpack(q)
        j = jump(tau, fit_rows)
        growth = -np.expm1(-tc / tau)
        curve = np.column_stack((j[ci] * growth, cov[cr] * tc, ov[cr] * tc[:, 0], work[cr] * growth[:, 0]))
        onset = np.column_stack((j[ri] / tau, cov[rr], ov[rr], work[rr] / tau[0]))
        return np.vstack((curve, onset))[:, cols]

    def project(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        a = design(q)
        return a @ lstsq(a, y, lapack_driver='gelsy')[0] - y

    def residual(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return design(v[:2]) @ v[2:] - y

    def mad(v: np.ndarray) -> float:
        return float(1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(v - np.median(v))))

    lower, upper = np.array([0., 1e-5]), np.array([1. - 1e-5, 1.])
    starts = ([.20, .35], [.35, .55], [.50, .75], [.65, .45])
    seeds = [least_squares(project, start, bounds=(lower, upper), loss='soft_l1', f_scale=.05, max_nfev=100) for start in starts]
    q = min(seeds, key=lambda opt: opt.cost).x
    v = np.r_[q, lstsq(design(q), y, lapack_driver='gelsy')[0]]
    bounds = (np.r_[lower, np.full(width, -np.inf)], np.r_[upper, np.full(width, np.inf)])
    for _ in range(2):
        err = residual(v)
        sigma = np.repeat([2.5 * max(1e-7, mad(err[:k])), 2.5 * max(1e-7, mad(err[k:]))], [k, rr.size])
        opt = least_squares(lambda value: residual(value) / sigma, v, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=400)
        v = opt.x
    sv = np.linalg.svd(opt.jac, compute_uv=False)
    if not opt.success or sv[-1] <= rank_rtol * sv[0]:
        raise ValueError('thresholded hereditary fit did not converge with identifiable parameters')
    tau = unpack(v[:2])
    w = np.zeros(base + 2)
    w[cols] = v[2:]
    amp = jump(tau, slice(None)) * w[:2]
    amp[:, 0] += work * w[base + 1]
    drift = cov @ w[2:base] + ov * w[base]
    onset = amp @ (1. / tau) + drift
    informed = ~train & miss.any(axis=1) & np.isfinite(rate)
    delta = np.zeros(n)
    if informed.any():
        noise_var = mad(rate[rr] - onset[rr]) ** 2
        latent = x[train] @ (miss[informed] * w[3:base]).T
        var = np.var(latent, axis=0)
        fraction = np.divide(var, var + noise_var, out=np.zeros_like(var), where=var + noise_var > 0)
        delta[informed] = fraction * (rate[informed] - onset[informed])
    growth = -np.expm1(-t[None, :] / tau[:, None])
    curve = initial[:, None] + strain_scale * (amp @ growth + (drift + delta)[:, None] * t)
    hereditary = w[:base] * np.r_[np.full(2, strain_scale / stress_scale), np.full(base - 2, rate_unit)]
    plastic_weights = w[base:] * rate_unit / stress_scale ** np.array([2, 3])
    return tau * time_scale, hereditary, plastic_weights, curve, rate_unit * (onset + delta)

def run_self_test():
    cmd = np.array([-.8, -.3, .2, .7, .9, .6, .8])
    labels = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1])
    measured = np.r_[1.2 * cmd[:5] + .14, .9 * .6 - .04, 2.]
    measured[4] += .8
    prior = np.array([[1., 0.], [.9, -.0405]])
    maps, local = calibrate_affine_gauges(cmd, measured, labels, np.array([0, 1]), stress_scale=2., prior=prior)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(local, [True, False])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(maps, [[1.2, .14], [.9, -.04]], atol=1e-12)
    # Reversing rows reverses orientations of the singly enumerated check pairs.
    f, k = .01, .5
    maps2, local2 = calibrate_affine_gauges(f * cmd[::-1], f * measured[::-1], 7 - labels[::-1], np.array([7, 6]), stress_scale=2. * f, prior=prior * [1., f])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(local2, local)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(maps2, maps * [1., f], atol=1e-12)

    rng = np.random.default_rng(51)
    n = 80
    idx = np.arange(n)
    group = idx % 2
    stratum = (idx // 2) % 3 == 0
    raw = rng.normal(size=(n, 4))
    raw[[-3, -2], 0] = np.nan
    ref = np.repeat((2 * ((idx // 2) % 2) - 1)[:, None], 3, axis=1)
    x, missing = align_reference_features(raw, ref, group, stratum)
    fill = np.mean([np.nanmean(raw[(group == g) & (stratum == s), 0]) for g in (0, 1) for s in (False, True)])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x[[-3, -2], 0], fill, atol=1e-12)
    gain = np.where(group == 0, 2., 5.)[:, None]
    offset = np.where(group == 0, -3., 4.)[:, None]
    x2, missing2 = align_reference_features(gain * raw + offset, gain * ref + offset, 7 - group, ~stratum)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(missing2, missing)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(x2, x, atol=1e-12)

    # Generate the constitutive response independently with chronological state recursion.
    h = rng.uniform(-1.4, 1.4, (n, 4))
    p = rng.choice([-1., 1.], n) * rng.uniform(.3, 1.6, n)
    h[1::4, 0] = -rng.uniform(2.2, 3.4, len(h[1::4]))
    h[3::4, 0] = rng.uniform(2.2, 3.4, len(h[3::4]))
    p[2::4] *= (2.5 / np.abs(p[2::4]))
    p[3::4] *= (2.7 / np.abs(p[3::4]))
    p[0] = 2.  # Exactly at yield is inactive.
    dt = np.array([.22, .65, .31, 1.1])
    t = np.linspace(0., 5., 24)
    eps0 = rng.uniform(-.01, .01, n)
    tau = np.array([.53, 2.45])
    w = np.array([.033, .017, .018, .004, -.003, .002, .0015])
    wp = np.array([.026, -.008])

    def response(hh, pp, taus, hereditary, plastic):
        memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
        work = np.zeros(n)
        for stress, step in zip(hh.T, dt):
            factor = np.exp(-step / taus)
            memory = memory * factor + stress[:, None] * (1. - factor)
            work += np.square(np.maximum(np.abs(stress) - 2., 0.)) * step
        amp = (pp[:, None] - memory) * hereditary[:2]
        amp[:, 0] += plastic[1] * work * pp
        drift = hereditary[2] + x @ hereditary[3:] + plastic[0] * np.sign(pp) * np.square(np.maximum(np.abs(pp) - 2., 0.))
        curve = eps0[:, None] + amp @ (1. - np.exp(-t / taus[:, None])) + drift[:, None] * t
        return curve, amp @ (1. / taus) + drift

    truth, onset = response(h, p, tau, w, wp)
    train = idx < n - 4
    obs = truth.copy()
    obs[~train] = np.nan
    obs[[4, 16, 29], [6, 11, 14]] += [.20, -.22, .25]
    rate = onset.copy()
    rate[train] += .00025 * rng.normal(size=train.sum())
    rate[15] += .15
    rate[-3] += .04
    rate[-2] = np.nan
    rate[-1] += .15  # Complete prediction rows must ignore their onset observations.
    kwargs = dict(time_scale=2., stress_scale=2., strain_scale=.05, yield_stress=2., tau_bounds=(.20, 8.))
    fit = fit_predict_thresholded(h, p, dt, t, eps0, x, missing, train, obs, rate, **kwargs)
    tf, wf, pf, pred, rf = fit
    assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in fit)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tf, tau, rtol=.012)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(wf, w, atol=3e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pf, wp, atol=3e-4)
    prior_curve, prior_rate = response(h, p, tf, wf, pf)
    err = rate[train] - prior_rate[train]
    noise2 = (1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(err - np.median(err)))) ** 2
    latent2 = np.var(x[train, 0] * wf[3])
    delta = latent2 / (latent2 + noise2) * (rate[-3] - prior_rate[-3])
    assert 0. < delta < rate[-3] - prior_rate[-3]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred[-3] - prior_curve[-3], delta * t, atol=1e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rf[-3] - prior_rate[-3], delta, atol=1e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred[[-2, -1]], truth[[-2, -1]], atol=6e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rf[[-2, -1]], prior_rate[[-2, -1]], atol=1e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred[:, 0], eps0, atol=1e-12)

    # Change the stress unit and halve all time quantities, preserving the
    # dimensionless experiment. There is no carrier or spatial graph here.
    scaled = dict(time_scale=2. * k, stress_scale=2. * f, strain_scale=.05, yield_stress=2. * f, tau_bounds=(.20 * k, 8. * k))
    tt, ww, pp, yy, rs = fit_predict_thresholded(f * h, f * p, k * dt, k * t, eps0, x2, missing2, train, obs, rate / k, **scaled)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tt / k, tf, rtol=2e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ww * np.r_[[f, f], np.full(5, k)], wf, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pp * k * f ** np.array([2, 3]), pf, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(yy, pred, atol=2e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(k * rs, rf, atol=2e-6)

    # Sub-yield training supports the Prony law but cannot identify plastic transfer.
    hs, ps = np.clip(h, -2., 2.), np.clip(p, -2., 2.)
    sub, sub_rate = response(hs, ps, tau, w, np.zeros(2))
    sub_rate[~train] = np.nan
    ts, ws, psfit, ys, rs = fit_predict_thresholded(hs, ps, dt, t, eps0, x, missing, train, sub, sub_rate, **kwargs)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(psfit, np.zeros(2))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ts, tau, rtol=1e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ws, w, atol=1e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(ys, sub, atol=1e-6)
    assert np.isfinite(rs).all()
    ps[-1] = 2.5
    with np.testing.assert_raises_regex(ValueError, 'training excitation'):
        fit_predict_thresholded(hs, ps, dt, t, eps0, x, missing, train, sub, sub_rate, **kwargs)


run_self_test()
